analysis_note: fun_prop has no differentiability rule for AddCircle.fourier. Build the two real-coordinate factors from the exact hasDerivAt_fourier_neg theorem, compose them with the real and imaginary coordinate maps, and multiply by the constant scale. The two fderiv declarations also incorrectly apply a global Differentiable theorem to w before projecting differentiableAt; remove that extra application.

replacements.new_fragment:
unfold literalStageNegativePlaneWave
  have hFourier (i : Fin 2) :
      Differentiable ℝ (fun x : ℝ =>
        fourier (-(k i)) ((x : ℝ) : UnitAddCircle)) :=
    fun x =>
      (hasDerivAt_fourier_neg (1 : ℝ) (k i) x).differentiableAt
  have hRe : Differentiable ℝ (fun w : ℂ =>
      fourier (-(k 0))
        (((literalStageFourierScale Y)⁻¹ * w.re : ℝ) : UnitAddCircle)) := by
    simpa only [Function.comp_apply] using
      (hFourier 0).comp
        (by fun_prop : Differentiable ℝ (fun w : ℂ =>
          (literalStageFourierScale Y)⁻¹ * w.re))
  have hIm : Differentiable ℝ (fun w : ℂ =>
      fourier (-(k 1))
        (((literalStageFourierScale Y)⁻¹ * w.im : ℝ) : UnitAddCircle)) := by
    simpa only [Function.comp_apply] using
      (hFourier 1).comp
        (by fun_prop : Differentiable ℝ (fun w : ℂ =>
          (literalStageFourierScale Y)⁻¹ * w.im))
  have hScale : Differentiable ℝ (fun _ : ℂ =>
      (((literalStageFourierScale Y)⁻¹ : ℝ) : ℂ)) :=
    differentiable_const
  exact (hScale.mul hRe).mul hIm
